description: Lines needing a bespoke mechanic found on a single card.
Let manaValueAtMost/AtLeast/equals and cast-free limits take a Value (announced X, mana spent, trigger object's mana value, damage dealt, lands controlled) instead of a fixed number.

feature: Announced X where a fixed number is required
description: Allow announced X or a Value for look-at-top, mill, connive, attack-tax, sacrifice-count and optional pay-X amounts.

feature: Per-player scope and chooser on effects
description: Add player-scope/chooser fields so sacrifice, search, copy and lose-life ops can target each player, a single opponent, or chosen players with filters like nontoken or creature-or-planeswalker.
Add a repeat-until-predicate or repeat-N-times op for reveal/exile/mill/draw sequences with leftover routing and chosen-name matching.

feature: Put onto battlefield tapped and attacking or attached
description: Add tapped (and attached) options to graveyard/exile-to-battlefield ops, including return-each and delayed returns.

feature: Trigger events and filters that do not exist yet
description: Add trigger events for an opponent playing a land, searching a library, a permanent untapping, creating a token, cards milled to graveyard, and a cause filter on trigger doubling.

Add conditions for seven differently named lands, the game turn number, attached-to-creature, greatest mana value among artifacts, per-opponent creature counts, and mana added by this ability this turn.
Add set-base-P/T with X values, add card types until end of turn, untargeted become-creature, and type changes on a returned object.

feature: Static permission to cast spells with flash
description: Add a static rule or effect letting players cast (matching) spells as though they had flash.
Add replacement effects that double life gain or life loss, triple damage, add flat damage, or double only noncombat damage.
Add CR 614 draw replacements (draw two instead, skip and draw, win instead, dredge) as a RuleStatic.

feature: Missing keyword mechanics (delve, echo, myriad, decayed, splice)
description: Add delve, echo, myriad, decayed and splice as keywords with their cost or token-copy mechanics.

feature: Effect references to the triggering object or event player
description: Let effects reference the trigger's spell, object or event player (counter it, gain control for the attacker, damage source, redirect a target to this creature).

feature: Selector predicates in targets and statics
description: Make powerAtMost usable in target filters and library searches and add a toughnessAtMost leaf.

feature: Variable-count target slots and chosen-count value
description: Support target counts bounded by announced X or chosen at resolution, with a delayed return of the whole chosen set.
Add condition fields to castFromGraveyard, castFromZone, cantCastSpells and attack/block restriction statics.
Add AbilityCost forms: exert, put a -1/-1 counter on this, mill a card, tap X untapped Myr on an attack trigger.

feature: Enter-with-counters rider on blink, reanimation and copy
description: Let blink and return ops reference the returned object to add counters, Roles or attachments (flying counter, +1/+1 on a Spirit, -1/-1 for persist).

feature: Count of objects affected by the previous effect
description: Add a Value counting what the preceding effect actually destroyed, sacrificed or killed in the same resolution.
Add become-copy of a graveyard card, until-end-of-turn enters-as-copy, copy that keeps an extra ability, and optional enter-tapped choice on copy.
Add sacrifice-at-end, tapped, per-token copy and exile-then-token-for-controller options to token creation ops.
Add ops that double or move only a named or chosen counter kind.

feature: Resolution-time creature type choice for spells
description: Add a choose-a-creature-type step on spell resolution whose result feeds later effects.

feature: Cast a card from other zones with a rider
description: Add cast-from-graveyard-with-condition, cast chosen graveyard card, and copy-exiled-card-and-cast-free ops.
Add static free-cast from hand, flashback granting for graveyard spells, and restriction of opponent casting to hand only.

feature: Grant spell keywords to later spells
description: Add effects or statics granting improvise or uncounterable to the next or all nonartifact spells.
Add hexproof-from-color, protection from colors outside commander identity, and protection from colorless or a chosen color.

feature: Grant landwalk, horsemanship and afflict keywords
description: Add landwalk (nonbasic, island), fear and similar evasion keywords to IMPLEMENTED_KEYWORDS and token specs.
Add Values for toughness of the trigger object or a target and a difference of two Values (excess damage).
Add selectors and per-affected-object values for sharing a creature type, and a target constraint tying two slots to a shared type.
Add mana abilities that multiply produced mana, give mana to the tapping player, or read the source's current power.

feature: Conditions on the triggering object or event player
description: Add conditions comparing the entering creature's name, the first combat phase, and cast-from-graveyard on a resolving spell.
Add 'you win the game' and 'you lose the game' effects and a cast-from-hand plus same-name-cast condition.
Add a Value reading the power of the permanent sacrificed as a cost, usable for draw and mill counts.
Add Value division with round-up or round-down (half power/toughness, half library, half life).

feature: Another player's optional choice on resolution
description: Add an effect where another player decides on resolution (opponent may search, opponent may tap the entering permanent) with a fallback branch.

feature: Counters read from events and other permanents
description: Add a Value for the number of counters placed in the triggering event.

feature: Statics that function from the graveyard
description: Let static effects with a zone-of-source test apply while the card is in its owner's graveyard.
Add a hand-zone mana ability with an exile-this-card-from-hand cost.
Add looking at a target player's hand or top card without revealing, discarding or moving it.

feature: Replacement effects redirecting where a card goes
description: Add replacements that exile a reanimated creature at end step and that reveal and shuffle a card into the library instead of the graveyard.

feature: Token copy color, type and cost overrides
description: Add color, subtype and no-mana-cost overrides to createTokenCopyOf for eternalize.
Add combat damage prevention filtered by creature subtype and for all your attackers.
Extend costReduction to activated abilities of your creatures and add Phyrexian-life payments for any colored symbol.

feature: Face-down pile split with opponent choice
description: Add two-pile split where an opponent separates revealed cards and the controller chooses which pile goes to hand.
Add either-or additional cost choice for spells.
Add a condition counting creatures that attacked this turn.
Add a conditional no-maximum-hand-size rule.

feature: Modern keyword actions (venture, ring tempts, suspect, crime)
description: Add the Ring tempts you / Ring-bearer action.
Add Treasure-specific extra-token replacement.
Add can't-be-blocked-by restriction keyed to the creatures of the chosen player.
